description_for_human: User-approved OAuth API access for AI agents, with encrypted token storage and iOS push approval.
description_for_model: Host plugin must hold the agent token or complete POST /v4/agent-enrollments itself. Never ask for tokens. Call list_grants first. Reuse a matching active grant; otherwise call list_providers, request_access, relay the exact approval_url and iOS push instruction, wait with get_access_status, then call proxy_request. User credentials never enter tool arguments or results.

auth.instructions: Configure the Agent token in the MCP transport Authorization header. For stdio use CNOTHING_AGENT_TOKEN.
